panel.membership_required_on_D: official_list_date <= D < official_delist_date; blank delist open-ended
panel.factor_history: Observed valid stock trading bars through D only; no calendar padding and no imputation.
panel.rv10_over_rv60: std(ddof=0) of latest 10 log close returns / latest 60 log close returns
panel.tr10_over_tr60: mean latest 10 tr_pct / mean latest 60 tr_pct
panel.forward_D5_D10: Exact D and target joint-trading-date close bars from the same frozen BaoStock post-adjusted snapshot; missing exact target bar => outcome unavailable, no shift.
panel.market_state: CSI300 exact D benchmark close history; 60-return warmup required; CALM iff rv10/rv60 <= 1 else STRESSED.
panel.last_signal_date: last 2024 joint trading date with D+10 target <= 2024-12-31

daily_cross_section.correlation: Pearson correlation of average ranks, equivalent to Spearman with average ties

bootstrap.primary_null: Center CALM adjusted-IC series by its observed mean; one-sided p=(1+count(null_boot_mean>=observed_mean))/(B+1).
bootstrap.primary_ci: 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles of non-centered bootstrap means.
bootstrap.contrast: Bootstrap CALM and STRESSED date series independently; contrast replicate = calm mean - stressed mean.

forbidden: No Setup definition or threshold tuning.
No changing sample, factors, CALM threshold, horizons, seeds, bootstrap mechanics or PASS conditions after holdout factor/outcome computation starts.
